audit_findings.title: Imported archive paths and metadata trusted
audit_findings.fix: safe_relative_path / is_safe_id at import and use; archive member cap (5000), symlink refusal, strict Project.load, owner/id overwritten, approvals reset unless importer is approver/admin, variant files routed through Project.variant_file

audit_findings.title: Hard constraint violated after reference-preserving regeneration but accepted
audit_findings.fix: constraint_checks evaluates every enabled rule on the final layout (order_below, keep_visible, min_text_size, clear_space, keep_group, anchor_edge, scale_range); hard rule -> PASS/FAIL CRITICAL, unevaluable hard rule -> NOT_CHECKED CRITICAL (blocks acceptance); reference plans that violate a hard rule are re-planned

audit_findings.title: Multi-run text styled by the first run only; PSD import reads the first style run
audit_findings.fix: per-run shaping/rendering on a shared baseline with size ratios, faces, colours and tracking; PSD extractor returns every style run; adapter builds TextRuns by run length; set_text keeps runs (edit_text) and accepts explicit runs; typography and font disclosure per run; unsupported attributes (underline, strikethrough, baseline shift) disclosed in import notes and element effects

audit_findings.title: UI has no authentication journey (401 with API keys)
audit_findings.fix: local users (PBKDF2), HttpOnly session cookie that authenticates pages, images and downloads, CSRF header on cookie-authenticated writes, first-run setup token, roles per user, member management, personal API tokens; AUTOBANNER_AUTH=local|api_key|open; never solved by disabling auth

audit_findings.title: Browser script uncommitted; tests depend on local fonts and generated files
audit_findings.fix: Playwright journey committed (backend/tests/e2e) and run in CI (browser-journey job); DejaVu Sans/Bold bundled under backend/app/fonts (Bitstream Vera licence); CJK test skips on measured glyph coverage instead of a font-name heuristic; H3 busy-background test generates its fixture
